# M0-a-13 — closing check of the hardening round S1 (lane check/M0-a-13-close-s1, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-14)

Lane `check/M0-a-13-close-s1`. The checker is Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, running in a Claude Code cloud container (Linux
x64, Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 4 cpu, 16 GiB, Node v24.12.0). `tools/machine_profile.py --id` printed
`linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib`. The checker is an independent, implementer-side closing checker.
It is not the round's author (`build/M0-a-13-fix-s1`, L-0526) and not an earlier checker of the item. Its ledger row is
**L-0527**. Under J269 this verdict goes to this file; `checks/M0-a-13.md` and `checks/M0-a-13-c1.md` stay as committed.

The seat ran no git command. It changed no item file. It read the git index's blob hashes from `.git/index` as a file
(see "Before-image"). It planned its mutants and probes from the brief, the source notes, the inventory rows and the
code. It read the author's mutant table only afterwards, to compare. Every mutant and probe ran in its own mirror,
`scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-13/`, a `cp -a` of `plat/`. Every symbolic link in the mirror resolves inside it (0 links
out). The gates ran on the shared tree. Every vitest run used the worker count of `tools/test_budget.py`, which printed 1
throughout (`--mutants`: 1). No `--` came before a vitest flag (J182).

## Verdict: PASS

All thirteen failing lines are fixed. Each row's fault, re-introduced as a mutant, turns its new pin red. Every gate in
scope exits 0, RELATED@1000 included (325 files, 4 121 tests, no red). The refusal census does not rise: 0 → 0. The check found no blocker. Three minor notes,
N-s1c-1 – N-s1c-3, are appended to `checks/M0-a-13-notes.md`. Each is a survivor on behaviour this round left unchanged,
and the code is right on every input those notes name.

## Before-image (how the checker obtained it without git)

The session restored `plat/` onto main uncommitted, so the git index holds the committed (pre-round) blob of every file.
The checker parsed `.git/index` with Python as a file, never a git command, and compared git blob sha1s for all 14 files
of the item's owns. The builder's saved copy `scratchpad/session-fix/a13-before/` equals the index on all 14 files (for
example `warp.ts` `bb875da7…`, `fixtures.test.ts` `16663660…`, `bfuzz.test.ts` `d056cd8d…`). The checker copied it into
its own mirror. The tree differs from the index in exactly six files: `src/warp/warp.ts` and `test/warp/{bfuzz,fixtures,
simplify,smooth,validate}.test.ts`. That is what the landed record and the LANDED line say. `src/warp/index.ts` is
byte-identical to the index, so the folder index and the barrel are unchanged (J263 Q1). The only code change is warp.ts:
placeOnRoute's test (i) and band became the module-level exports `onRoutePixel` and `hotPixelCandidates`. Read by
inspection, the diff is the same loop. The `tried` set held only `near` when the band was built, and `qx === near.x`
matches the string key, `-0` included.
